title: Dread Warren round 5: entrances hidden in the world, galleries from inside, Lights out again
desc: J rated v2.0109 (every entrance and hall dropped: "these were all scrappable"), then picked "Hidden in the world" and "Yes, from inside". W1a4-6: a ravine ledge, an old mineshaft and a river bank seen from eye height; W1b4-6: three galleries from where you stand. Both are clips: CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER ("I would prefer you only see the webs once youre in danger"). W3c1 and W3c3: three new versions of each Lights out IMPROVE, with less yellow ("too much yellow") and the construct spider rim-lit so its body reads. No Matron; ceiling walking still on hold.

takes.name: Entrance: ravine ledge
takes.facts: an ordinary ravine in a grass plain; on the far wall, a few blocks down, a ledge and a dark hole half-hidden by hanging roots, the kind of spot you'd climb down to for ore; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a4 Entrance: ravine ledge

takes.name: Entrance: old mineshaft
takes.facts: an abandoned mineshaft in a hillside: timber frames, a rail line, a little gravel slide at the mouth. It looks like any old mine until the timbers turn out to be wound in silk; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a5 Entrance: old mineshaft

takes.name: Entrance: river bank
takes.facts: a quiet river; under the grassy lip of the far bank, behind the reeds, a low dark gap just above the water; from eye height where you'd stand. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open, a Hunter comes out
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a6 Entrance: river bank

takes.name: Weave Gallery inside: silk cathedral
takes.facts: a tall nave, 9 wide and 15 high, ribs arching over you every 4 blocks (no columns), burrows in both walls; in danger four huge webs across the nave light up like stained glass and a Hunter drops on its thread in front of you; from inside, standing where you would, your ring the only lamp. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open in the burrows
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b4 Weave Gallery inside: silk cathedral

takes.name: Weave Gallery inside: winding hall
takes.facts: a lower hall that winds left and right so you only see to the next bend; in danger webs light up across every bend and a Hunter drops just ahead; from inside, standing where you would, your ring the only lamp. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open in the burrows
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b5 Weave Gallery inside: winding hall

takes.name: Weave Gallery inside: ledge over the pit
takes.facts: you walk a narrow ledge along the left wall over a deep dark pit; in danger nets of silk across the pit light up below you and Hunters climb them toward you; from inside, standing where you would, your ring the only lamp. The clip runs CALM for 3 seconds, then DANGER: the webs fade in and glow, eyes open in the burrows
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b6 Weave Gallery inside: ledge over the pit
